headline: Subshell 1.0 release candidate: the same app as 0.92, out for a last check of updating from inside the app
highlights: This is the release candidate for 1.0. The app is the same as 0.92; it is out so updating from inside the app can be checked once more before 1.0.
If Update or What's new does not work for you, tell us on r/subshell or GitHub.
